in_marathi.name: Sanavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity and abundance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sanavi is a beautiful Hindu name for girls, derived from the Sanskrit word 'san' meaning prosperity and 'vi' meaning abundance. This name signifies the blessings of the goddess of wealth and prosperity, and is believed to bring happiness, wealth, and good fortune to the child.
